# Load libraries

Load the necessary libraries.
```{r, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
library(Seurat)
library(SeuratObject)
library(dplyr)
library(MASS)
library(viridis)
library(stringr)
library(patchwork)
library(ggplot2)
library(readr)
library(STEAM)
library(tidyr)
library(reshape2)
library(ggnewscale)
library(ComplexHeatmap)
library(circlize)
```


# Load data


Fisher exact results.
```{r}
ALS_all <- read.table(file = "DEG_output/Fishers_exact_test_ALS_all_genes_stratified.csv", sep = ";", header = T)
BIP_all <- read.table(file = "DEG_output/Fishers_exact_test_BIP_all_genes_stratified.csv", sep = ";", header = T)
MDD_all <- read.table(file = "DEG_output/Fishers_exact_test_MDD_all_genes_stratified.csv", sep = ";", header = T)
PAR_all <- read.table(file = "DEG_output/Fishers_exact_test_PAR_all_genes_stratified.csv", sep = ";", header = T)
SCZ_all <- read.table(file = "DEG_output/Fishers_exact_test_SCZ_all_genes_stratified.csv", sep = ";", header = T)
```


Add cell type annotations.
```{r}
cell_anno <- c(NSC = 2, INP = 3, NB = 3, YGN = 2, GN = 3)

cell_type_vec <- rep(names(cell_anno), times = cell_anno)

MDD_all$cell_type <- cell_type_vec
ALS_all$cell_type <- cell_type_vec
BIP_all$cell_type <- cell_type_vec
PAR_all$cell_type <- cell_type_vec
SCZ_all$cell_type <- cell_type_vec

```


# Build heatmap


```{r, fig.height=6, fig.width=10}
library(ComplexHeatmap)
library(circlize)
library(viridisLite)
library(grid)  # for grid.text and unit

# ---------------------------
# 1. Combine data
# ---------------------------
df_list <- list(
  BIP = BIP_all,
  MDD = MDD_all,
  SCZ = SCZ_all,
  ALS = ALS_all,
  PAR = PAR_all
)

# X-axis ordering based on MDD_all clusters
clusters <- MDD_all$cluster

# ---------------------------
# 2. Build log2_OR matrix
# ---------------------------
log2_or_mat <- do.call(
  rbind,
  lapply(df_list, function(df) {
    df <- df[match(clusters, df$cluster), ]
    df$log2_OR
  })
)

rownames(log2_or_mat) <- names(df_list)
colnames(log2_or_mat) <- clusters

# ---------------------------
# 3. Build star matrix based on adj_p_value
# ---------------------------
p_to_stars <- function(p) {
  cut(
    p,
    breaks = c(-Inf, 1e-4, 1e-3, 1e-2, 0.05, Inf),
    labels = c("****", "***", "**", "*", ""),
    right = FALSE
  )
}

star_mat <- do.call(
  rbind,
  lapply(df_list, function(df) {
    df <- df[match(clusters, df$cluster), ]
    as.character(p_to_stars(df$adj_p_value))
  })
)

rownames(star_mat) <- names(df_list)
colnames(star_mat) <- clusters

# ---------------------------
# 4. Shorten cluster names for display
# ---------------------------
colnames(log2_or_mat) <- sub("^pt_window_", "", colnames(log2_or_mat))
colnames(star_mat) <- colnames(log2_or_mat)

# ---------------------------
# 5. Clip Inf values and define full viridis color scale
# ---------------------------
log2_or_mat_clipped <- log2_or_mat
finite_vals <- log2_or_mat[is.finite(log2_or_mat)]
log2_or_mat_clipped[!is.finite(log2_or_mat_clipped)] <- max(finite_vals)

n_breaks <- 100
breaks <- seq(min(finite_vals), max(finite_vals), length.out = n_breaks)
colors <- viridis(n_breaks, option = "D")
col_fun <- colorRamp2(breaks, colors)

# ---------------------------
# 6. Define bottom cell type annotation
# ---------------------------
cell_colors <- c(
  "NSC" = "#FC8D62",
  "INP" = "#E78AC3",
  "NB"  = "#8DA0CB",
  "YGN" = "#A6D854",
  "GN"  = "#66C2A5"
)

cell_type_vec <- MDD_all$cell_type[match(clusters, MDD_all$cluster)]
cell_type_vec_factor <- factor(cell_type_vec, levels = unique(cell_type_vec))  # preserve order

bottom_ha <- HeatmapAnnotation(
  CellType = cell_type_vec_factor,
  col = list(CellType = cell_colors),
  annotation_name_side = "left"
)

# ---------------------------
# 7. Define left row annotation for disorder groups
# ---------------------------
row_group <- c(
  BIP = "Neuropsychiatric",
  MDD = "Neuropsychiatric",
  SCZ = "Neuropsychiatric",
  ALS = "Neurodegenerative",
  PAR = "Neurodegenerative"
)

row_group_vec <- factor(row_group[rownames(log2_or_mat_clipped)],
                        levels = c("Neuropsychiatric", "Neurodegenerative"))

row_colors <- c(
  "Neuropsychiatric" = "#B0B0B0",
  "Neurodegenerative" = "#505050"
)

left_ha <- rowAnnotation(
  Group = row_group_vec,
  col = list(Group = row_colors),
  annotation_name_side = "top"
)

# ---------------------------
# 8. Draw heatmap
# ---------------------------
p <- Heatmap(
  log2_or_mat_clipped,
  name = "log2(OR)",
  col = col_fun,
  cluster_rows = FALSE,
  cluster_columns = FALSE,
  row_title = "Complex traits",
  column_title = "Pseudotime ordered windows",
  column_title_side = "bottom",
  row_names_side = "left",
  column_names_rot = 0,
  bottom_annotation = bottom_ha,
  left_annotation = left_ha,
  cell_fun = function(j, i, x, y, w, h, fill) {
    grid::grid.text(
      star_mat[i, j],
      x, y,
      gp = grid::gpar(fontsize = 12)
    )
  },
  width = unit(ncol(log2_or_mat_clipped), "cm"),
  height = unit(nrow(log2_or_mat_clipped), "cm")
)

# Render heatmap
p

```


```{r, fig.height=6, fig.width=10}
library(ComplexHeatmap)
library(circlize)
library(viridisLite)
library(grid)  # for grid.text and unit

# ---------------------------
# 1. Combine data
# ---------------------------
df_list <- list(
  BIP = BIP_all,
  MDD = MDD_all,
  SCZ = SCZ_all,
  ALS = ALS_all,
  PAR = PAR_all
)

# X-axis ordering based on MDD_all clusters
clusters <- MDD_all$cluster

# ---------------------------
# 2. Build log2_OR matrix
# ---------------------------
log2_or_mat <- do.call(
  rbind,
  lapply(df_list, function(df) {
    df <- df[match(clusters, df$cluster), ]
    df$log2_OR
  })
)

rownames(log2_or_mat) <- names(df_list)
colnames(log2_or_mat) <- clusters

# ---------------------------
# 3. Build star matrix based on adj_p_value
# ---------------------------
p_to_stars <- function(p) {
  cut(
    p,
    breaks = c(-Inf, 1e-4, 1e-3, 1e-2, 0.05, Inf),
    labels = c("****", "***", "**", "*", ""),
    right = FALSE
  )
}

star_mat <- do.call(
  rbind,
  lapply(df_list, function(df) {
    df <- df[match(clusters, df$cluster), ]
    as.character(p_to_stars(df$adj_p_value))
  })
)

rownames(star_mat) <- names(df_list)
colnames(star_mat) <- clusters

# ---------------------------
# 4. Shorten cluster names for display
# ---------------------------
colnames(log2_or_mat) <- sub("^pt_window_", "", colnames(log2_or_mat))
colnames(star_mat) <- colnames(log2_or_mat)

# ---------------------------
# 5. Clip Inf values while preserving sign
# ---------------------------
log2_or_mat_clipped <- log2_or_mat

finite_vals <- log2_or_mat[is.finite(log2_or_mat)]
max_val <- max(finite_vals)
min_val <- min(finite_vals)

# Only clip +Inf, leave -Inf for grey cells
log2_or_mat_clipped[log2_or_mat == Inf] <- max_val

n_breaks <- 100
breaks <- seq(min_val, max_val, length.out = n_breaks)
colors <- viridis(n_breaks, option = "D")
col_fun <- colorRamp2(breaks, colors)

# ---------------------------
# 6. Define bottom cell type annotation
# ---------------------------
cell_colors <- c(
  "NSC" = "#FC8D62",
  "INP" = "#E78AC3",
  "NB"  = "#8DA0CB",
  "YGN" = "#A6D854",
  "GN"  = "#66C2A5"
)

cell_type_vec <- MDD_all$cell_type[match(clusters, MDD_all$cluster)]
cell_type_vec_factor <- factor(cell_type_vec, levels = unique(cell_type_vec))  # preserve order

bottom_ha <- HeatmapAnnotation(
  CellType = cell_type_vec_factor,
  col = list(CellType = cell_colors),
  annotation_name_side = "left"
)

# ---------------------------
# 7. Define left row annotation for disorder groups
# ---------------------------
row_group <- c(
  BIP = "Neuropsychiatric",
  MDD = "Neuropsychiatric",
  SCZ = "Neuropsychiatric",
  ALS = "Neurodegenerative",
  PAR = "Neurodegenerative"
)

row_group_vec <- factor(row_group[rownames(log2_or_mat_clipped)],
                        levels = c("Neuropsychiatric", "Neurodegenerative"))

row_colors <- c(
  "Neuropsychiatric" = "#B0B0B0",
  "Neurodegenerative" = "#505050"
)

left_ha <- rowAnnotation(
  Group = row_group_vec,
  col = list(Group = row_colors),
  annotation_name_side = "top"
)

# ---------------------------
# 8. Draw heatmap with grey for -Inf cells
# ---------------------------
p <- Heatmap(
  log2_or_mat_clipped,
  name = "log2(OR)",
  col = col_fun,
  cluster_rows = FALSE,
  cluster_columns = FALSE,
  row_title = "Complex traits",
  column_title = "Pseudotime ordered windows",
  column_title_side = "bottom",
  row_names_side = "left",
  column_names_rot = 0,
  bottom_annotation = bottom_ha,
  left_annotation = left_ha,

  cell_fun = function(j, i, x, y, w, h, fill) {

    if (log2_or_mat[i, j] == -Inf) {
      # grey cell for zero overlap
      grid::grid.rect(
        x, y, w, h,
        gp = grid::gpar(fill = "grey80", col = NA)
      )
    } else {
      # normal colored cell
      grid::grid.rect(
        x, y, w, h,
        gp = grid::gpar(fill = fill, col = NA)
      )
    }

    # draw stars
    grid::grid.text(
      star_mat[i, j],
      x, y,
      gp = grid::gpar(fontsize = 12)
    )
  },

  width = unit(ncol(log2_or_mat_clipped), "cm"),
  height = unit(nrow(log2_or_mat_clipped), "cm")
)

# Render heatmap
p

```



```{r, fig.height=6, fig.width=10}
library(ComplexHeatmap)
library(circlize)
library(viridisLite)
library(grid)  # for grid.text and unit

# ---------------------------
# 1. Combine data
# ---------------------------
df_list <- list(
  BIP = BIP_all,
  MDD = MDD_all,
  SCZ = SCZ_all,
  ALS = ALS_all,
  PAR = PAR_all
)

clusters <- MDD_all$cluster  # X-axis ordering

# ---------------------------
# 2. Build log2_OR matrix
# ---------------------------
log2_or_mat <- do.call(
  rbind,
  lapply(df_list, function(df) {
    df <- df[match(clusters, df$cluster), ]
    df$log2_OR
  })
)

rownames(log2_or_mat) <- names(df_list)
colnames(log2_or_mat) <- clusters

# ---------------------------
# 3. Build star matrix
# ---------------------------
p_to_stars <- function(p) {
  cut(
    p,
    breaks = c(-Inf, 1e-4, 1e-3, 1e-2, 0.05, Inf),
    labels = c("****", "***", "**", "*", ""),
    right = FALSE
  )
}

star_mat <- do.call(
  rbind,
  lapply(df_list, function(df) {
    df <- df[match(clusters, df$cluster), ]
    as.character(p_to_stars(df$adj_p_value))
  })
)

rownames(star_mat) <- names(df_list)
colnames(star_mat) <- clusters

# ---------------------------
# 4. Shorten cluster names for display
# ---------------------------
colnames(log2_or_mat) <- sub("^pt_window_", "", colnames(log2_or_mat))
colnames(star_mat) <- colnames(log2_or_mat)

# ---------------------------
# 5. Convert -Inf to NA for grey cells
# ---------------------------
log2_or_mat_clipped <- log2_or_mat
log2_or_mat_clipped[log2_or_mat_clipped == -Inf] <- NA

finite_vals <- log2_or_mat_clipped[is.finite(log2_or_mat_clipped)]
min_val <- min(finite_vals)
max_val <- max(finite_vals)

n_breaks <- 100
breaks <- seq(min_val, max_val, length.out = n_breaks)
colors <- viridis(n_breaks, option = "D")
col_fun <- colorRamp2(breaks, colors)

# ---------------------------
# 6. Bottom cell type annotation
# ---------------------------
cell_colors <- c(
  "NSC" = "#FC8D62",
  "INP" = "#E78AC3",
  "NB"  = "#8DA0CB",
  "YGN" = "#A6D854",
  "GN"  = "#66C2A5"
)

cell_type_vec <- MDD_all$cell_type[match(clusters, MDD_all$cluster)]
cell_type_vec_factor <- factor(cell_type_vec, levels = unique(cell_type_vec))

bottom_ha <- HeatmapAnnotation(
  CellType = cell_type_vec_factor,
  col = list(CellType = cell_colors),
  annotation_name_side = "left"
)

# ---------------------------
# 7. Left row annotation for disorder groups
# ---------------------------
row_group <- c(
  BIP = "Neuropsychiatric",
  MDD = "Neuropsychiatric",
  SCZ = "Neuropsychiatric",
  ALS = "Neurodegenerative",
  PAR = "Neurodegenerative"
)

row_group_vec <- factor(row_group[rownames(log2_or_mat_clipped)],
                        levels = c("Neuropsychiatric", "Neurodegenerative"))

row_colors <- c(
  "Neuropsychiatric" = "#B0B0B0",
  "Neurodegenerative" = "#505050"
)

left_ha <- rowAnnotation(
  Group = row_group_vec,
  col = list(Group = row_colors),
  annotation_name_side = "top"
)

# ---------------------------
# 8. Draw heatmap with NA cells in grey
# ---------------------------
p <- Heatmap(
  log2_or_mat_clipped,
  name = "log2(OR)",
  col = col_fun,
  cluster_rows = T,
  cluster_columns = FALSE,
  row_title = "Complex traits",
  column_title = "Pseudotime ordered windows",
  column_title_side = "bottom",
  row_names_side = "left",
  column_names_rot = 0,
  bottom_annotation = bottom_ha,
  left_annotation = left_ha,

  cell_fun = function(j, i, x, y, w, h, fill) {

    if (is.na(log2_or_mat_clipped[i, j])) {
      # grey cell for zero overlap
      grid::grid.rect(
        x, y, w, h,
        gp = grid::gpar(fill = "grey80", col = NA)
      )
    } else {
      # normal colored cell
      grid::grid.rect(
        x, y, w, h,
        gp = grid::gpar(fill = fill, col = NA)
      )
    }

    # draw stars
    grid::grid.text(
      star_mat[i, j],
      x, y,
      gp = grid::gpar(fontsize = 12)
    )
  },

  width = unit(ncol(log2_or_mat_clipped), "cm"),
  height = unit(nrow(log2_or_mat_clipped), "cm")
)

p
```
